dedupe_keys.name: experimentellt dataset for laster pa tunnelinkladnader med utbredd fiberoptisk monitorering och digital bildkorrelation

description: Experimentellt dataset för laster på tunnelinklädnader med utbredd fiberoptisk monitorering och digital bildkorrelation is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Chalmers University of Technology. The data is collected during experiments that aims to reproduce loading conditions in shotcrete tunnel linings. The data includes strain measurements from distributed optical fiber sensors, image series taken simultaneously by two cameras for digital image correlation purposes and load-, displacement- and pressure measurements by load cells, LVDTs and pressure gauges respectively. Coverage: Chalmers University of Technology. The portal shows the English title as "Experimental data for loads on tunnel linings including distributed optical fiber sensing and digital image correlation" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Chalmers University of Technology. Its keywords include shotcrete, load-bearing structures, betong, concrete, tunnel construction, fibre optics. The listing shows 2024-10-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
